name: Mobile Hearing Assessment Outreach
description: An additional mobile hearing assessment service pathway targeting regional and remote or very remote communities.
intended_service_change: Provide an additional pathway for accessing hearing assessment services.
assumptions: The intervention is a proposed scenario, not an established Australian service.
The intervention does not guarantee service availability or individual attendance.
Its effect on access, waiting times and outcomes has not yet been established.
One remote outreach visit is scheduled every three months.
Each remote visit provides a maximum of two initial assessment appointments.
Remote round-trip travel time is randomly generated once per experiment, greater than two hours and less than twelve hours.
Remote travel uses the existing clinician and does not create additional workforce capacity.
Remote travel-time values are illustrative simulation assumptions, not measured Australian travel times.
